title: Choose the visual world for Sculpt Workspace
question: The roll assigned Quarry Block Marking. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Quarry Block Marking
options.lineage: Carrara marble blocks stencilled with lot numbers and paint marks before they leave the quarry
options.thesis: Every revision is a numbered block cut from the original; the original carries the quarry's protected mark.
options.viewport: Top bar + workspace: a 2x2 render plate grid at left, a revision rail at right where each revision is a stencilled block number; the original block wears a red protected mark.
options.risk: Stencil numerals can tip into costume if used beyond revision numbers.

raised.raise: Render plates register at one fixed scale and baseline so revisions compare frame-for-frame.
Plate corners carry registration crosshairs that echo each render's camera frame metadata.
Job state reads in line form as well as hue: dashed queued, solid running, struck failed.

options.label: Conservation Condition Report
options.lineage: museum registrar object files and condition reports
options.thesis: Each project is an accessioned object; each revision a dated condition entry against the original.
options.viewport: An object file: accession UUID header, four views as catalogue photographs, a ledger of condition entries.
options.risk: Familiar archival-paper look; the most likely landing for this category.

options.label: Design Annual Plate Section
options.lineage: design annual plate pages with registration furniture
options.thesis: Renders presented as registered plates on near-white stock with hairline credit rows.
options.viewport: A 4-up plate row of renders with mono credit rows beneath each.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on render presentation; weaker on revision and protection story.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio rather than a supervisor console.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: botanical plates at fixed scale across seasons
options.thesis: One subject tracked through stages at identical scale.
options.viewport: Five fixed-scale plates on one baseline.
options.case: Revision comparison maps well, but cream-and-serif is the wrong register for a tech artist's console.
options.kept: Fixed-scale registration of plates across revisions.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: State carried by line form on a charcoal continuum.
options.viewport: Everything hangs off one off-centre rail.
options.case: Instrument costume on a working screen; obscures standard navigation.
options.kept: State encoded in line form, not only hue.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.viewport: A pastel grid of project cells.
options.kept: Whole-cell reflow of the recent-projects list.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark dev-tool dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dev dashboard.
